programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Mixed Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa­Laa and Po have their favourite things. The bag, the hat, the scooter and the ball all magically swap places and become mixed up.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss seeks to clean up his image and win the mayoral seat amid a regime change. To raise funds and eliminate rivals, he sends Zheng Zha and Su Wan into action. When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Teacher of the Year
programme.desc: Mrs. Hogenmuller is being evaluated for a “Teacher of the Year” award, and Olivia is determined to make sure everything goes smoothly. But despite her best efforts, chaos ensues. Luckily, she has a plan to show Mrs. H. that she doesn’t need an award to be teacher of the year in the eyes of her students!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Little Big House
programme.desc: When Dad’s elaborate scale house model is destroyed, Olivia takes it upon herself to build another one before Dad returns home with his important client. What’s more, her version will be better, redder, and bigger – so big that she and Ian have to build it in the backyard!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Olivia Talks Turkey
programme.desc: Inspired by Mrs. Hogenmuller, Olivia takes up a new hobby – turkey calling! She turns out to be a natural, and before long, she’s attracted a turkey. But when the turkey takes a real liking to her and refuses to leave her side, Olivia has to find a way to make it leave her alone!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Takes a Hike
programme.desc: Dad accompanies Olivia and Francine as they set out to earn a Pioneer Scouts merit badge by planting a flag atop Maywood Hill. Along the way, the trio faces one obstacle after another – including a skunk! But thanks to Olivia’s preparedness, they overcome each hurdle and make it to the top!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Frankengymteacher's Monster Radio Blodge
programme.desc: Frankengymteacher’s Monster ‐ Frankengymteacher is overloaded with work, so he decides to build a clone to help him out. Only problem: the brain settings of this FGT2 have been rebooted to “terror” mode! FGT2 goes to Deedstown to terrorize fleshies! FGT, with Casper’s help, must hide FGT2 from Alder and Dash. But when FGT2 decides to replace FGT, Casper’s got to find a solution to restore peace in Deedstown and in Scare School. Radio Blodge ‐ Casper and Blodge get caught after using Alder &amp; Dash

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Davey Jones Locker Save Graham
programme.desc: Davey Jones Locker ‐ In gym class, Thatch humiliates Casper by beating him in a duel. Casper is so upset, that he does something completely out of character and tricks Thatch into opening an old locker that holds the evil spirit of the pirate, Davey Jones. When his spirit enters Dummy Girl’s body and uses her to put the whole school under his command Casper must fix his mistake before Davey Jones takes the Galleon and maybe even Deedstown too! Save Graham ‐ While chasing Thatch, Graham manages t

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Where’s The Party? The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spark Bees Best in Show
programme.desc: The kids scare away a swarm of bees. But when they realize bees make the flowers happy, they hatch a plan to get them back! When Scallop makes a bad choice, Kelp helps her learn from her mistakes.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Superfan Barb
programme.desc: Kelp and the rest of his friends put on a game of rainbow ball, but Kelp begins to wonder how well his special spark can help him truly measure up to his favorite player. When the underwater friends meet someone new, they’re reminded that their differences make them unique.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Double Finked
programme.desc: Magnus's nephew, Axel, arrives on the island and tells the Rescue Riders that he wants to join their team. But is he just a trickster like his uncle?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Divewings
programme.desc: When sea-dwelling dragons called Divewings start attacking ships near the island, the Rescue Riders have to find out what's making them so upset.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers
programme.desc: Kitty Ranger Team Leader Mama Box helps Kitty Ranger Gabby and Pandy get a lost Baby Me-Owl back home to its Mama in the Fairy Tale Garden. They embark on a hiking adventure! They learn about animal tracking, earn patches along the way, and ultimately, reunite Baby with Mama!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - I Love Lucia
programme.desc: The habitat is celebrating “Sloth Day” in honor of its newest arrival: cool, chill, Lucia the sloth, who just arrived from Costa Rica! At first, the gang is excited to have a new friend, but soon the whole zoo develops sloth fever; everywhere they go, people are walking around in sloth masks-- even Kate is fawning over her! Melman, accustomed to getting lots of attention as the baby of the group, worries that Kate loving Lucia will mean less love and attention for him! When Lucia overhears Melma

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Happy Snooze Year
programme.desc: When Melman learns that his friends stay up late every New Year’s Eve to watch the ball drop in Times Square, he’s determined to stay up with the big kids and join the fun. But as the night goes on, an exhausted Melman causes total chaos for himself and the gang. He ultimately realizes that missing your bedtime isn’t all its cracked up to be

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - The Saddle-Ridge Cup Mayor Brock
programme.desc: Archibald accidentally volunteers a rag-tag group of Crackridge locals in an important game of Crackarack against Saddlerock. When Mayor Fowler is away for the day, Archibald assumes Brock is now the Mayor of Crackridge.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Skunked! Neighborhood Bird Watch
programme.desc: Archibald can’t wait to celebrate his Hatch Day with his family inside an impossibly fun theme park. But when Archibald accidentally gets sprayed by a skunk, he must try to get rid of his stank before his special day is ruined. When Archibald overhears something suspicious about a neighbor, he reports it to his aunts who run the Neighborhood Bird Watch. With Archibald as their new recruit, they attempt to expose the neighbor’s suspicious shenanigans.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Almost Famoose: Chapter Two
programme.desc: A video of Rocky and Bullwinkle playing a song goes viral and they’re rocketed to musical superstardom. They decide to use their newfound celebrity to launch a “save the birdbath” concert tour to restore the giant birdbath they destroyed.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Almost Famoose: Chapter Three
programme.desc: Rocky, Bullwinkle, Boris and Natasha are kidnapped by a super-fan named Francis, the eight-year-old heir to the Puffy Platypus Pizza franchise, to play a private concert for his birthday.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Gimme, Gimme, Gimme: The Game
programme.desc: King Julien becomes so enthralled with the idea of money that he introduces it to the kingdom.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Body Double
programme.desc: In preparation for peace talks with the crocodiles, King Julien hires a body double to go in his place.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Tip's Deep Dish Garbage Day
programme.desc: When Tip loses her voice, Oh finds a way to use his own voice to talk to her crush Keanu; Oh invents a way to redo yesterday so Tip can redeem a rotten day.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Very Foreign Exchange Student Pig's Tail
programme.desc: Tip's new friend, the Roidian, stays with the Tuccis in hopes of learning from humans; Tip accidentally swaps bodies with Pig.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The English Opening
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.desc: Determined for Grug and Guy to bond, Eep plans a hunt for the three of them. But when Eep sneakily makes it appear that Guy saved Grug from a charging bearacuda, the two believe Guy is a master hunter, and head to hunt a dangerous scorpulion.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - I.O. Crood
programme.desc: When Grug saves Hope's life during a dangerous mountainside tartichoke harvest, rather than feeling grateful, Hope is desperate to save Grug's life in order to not be indebted to him.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Appetite for Deception
programme.desc: Determined to show Hope that she's just as good a cook, Ugga decides to cook a meal that will wow the farm residents. But when Ugga realizes she's out of her element, she turns to the punch monkeys for help.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Rescue
programme.desc: Tony’s been kidnapped..by Sudarikov! The rest of the team must break into the plane where Tony’s being held and rescue him – all while 30,000 feet in the air!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Anchors Away
programme.desc: The team manages to rescue Tony, but not before Sudarikov sends their plane crashing into the ocean. Now they’re trapped underwater and must defend themselves against falling torpedoes, AI enemy submarines, and their most dangerous foe yet: the sea! Cisco takes command of the hauler-turned-sub, waging a daring underwater battle.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Driving and Crying
programme.desc: Tony realizes he’s lost his ability to drive! With the team stranded on a deserted island in the South Pacific and enemies rapidly approaching (including Scandan), the team tries to rehab Tony’s driving in order to get them all to safety.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 2
programme.desc: Unaware of the war on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup, Snotlout and Johann discover an island full of dragons that have been wounded by the Dragon Hunters

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Shock And Awe
programme.desc: When a new dragon is found in Edge Cove, the Dragon Riders must help the Sea Shocker escape a group of hungry Scauldrons

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - A Time To Skrill
programme.desc: When the Skrill returns with a vendetta against Hiccup and Toothless, the Dragon Riders must choose a new course of action to stop the vicious dragon

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bombastic Blathering of Brainy Blabulous
programme.desc: When Krupp transfers to another school, George and Harold follow, only to find a bizarro version of Jerome Horwitz Elementary, where the teachers are nice and the kids are well-behaved. But no one's having any fun! George and Harold want to right this wrong with pranks and comics. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer (bizarro Meaner), who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in order to stop the subversion of authority.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Crazy Caustic Spray of the Contagious Cruelius Sneezer
programme.desc: In order to spice up their field trip to Romeinday (an ancient Rome reenactment park), George and Harold trick Melvin into turning the bus into a time machine so they can travel to actual ancient Rome and be gladiators. After offending Caesar with their comic, the emperor is accidentally turned into Cruelius Sneezer and pursues the school group with all his might.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Trashy Tale of the Tumultuous Tubbadump
programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. But Melvin creates an invention to suck all the trash into another dimension. The plan backfires when Tubbadump, a trash-covered monster, emerges from that dimension for revenge on the trashmakers.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Floaties
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Breaking The Bank
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits heists the underwater Baby Bank in an attempt to steal all the funds from Boss and Tina’s new company. Boss, Tina and Banker Baby Benny must infiltrate the bank via submarine to stop this high-stakes aquatic robbery. But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Hate That Baby!
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.desc: After Aunt Cora moves out, Lucky tries to live a life without rules.

programme.title: Brutally Young - EP8

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第2集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 行动现场第566集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第283集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第49集

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第209集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行动现场第567集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第2集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第282集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第283集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第40集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 365日日素第205集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透过简单的烹调方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第1044集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 映照人生第527集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 守护大自然第2集
programme.desc: 印尼原住民族世代与自然共存，以传统智慧守护森林、海洋与土地。面对开发变迁，仍坚守文化及生态平衡，为后代留下珍贵传承。

programme.title: 大爱全纪实第199集
programme.desc: 慈济四大八法推广与传播,关注地球与人类永续发展议题。 解读近代事件中，慈济「曾经」参与的足迹，至今「正在」持续的行动，以及留给「未来」的影响力。 为观众传播慈济四大八法，剖析探讨慈济人如何关注地球永续发展、推动拔苦予乐的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文讲堂第548集
programme.desc: 《人文讲堂》节目，邀请台湾各行各业杰出人士、学者专家，或热爱生命者，将多年的学识涵养、人文感受，以及对生命的活力，以讲演方式，直接与大众分享。讲演的内容及方式，不再流于传统，不仅是知识或专业技术而已，更会呈现出特有的人文观点。

programme.title: 映照人生第527集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 行动现场第567集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第5集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨龄差距的结伴青春旅行，走访在地文化行销台湾，世代差异的旅游个性激荡出充满意外性的实境自助旅行。当稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，会擦出什么火花呢?这是一段花甲老熟肉与少年小鲜肉们，跨越大龄差距，结伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鲜肉们想什么？而老熟肉们又会怎么玩？透过世代差异，激荡出观众意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅游实境节目，纪录跨世代的艺人们难忘的友情之旅！从陌生到熟悉！ 从畏惧到麻吉！让小鲜肉成长！让老熟肉回春！不啰唆！现在出发吧～

programme.title: 我们的岛第1381集
programme.desc: 一个一小时的节目，能带给观众什么，能影响什么？如果把它只当成一个节目，会感觉短短一小时很短暂，如果把它当成一条出路，会发现力量也可以很强大，一直以来，我们节目的理念就是寻求一种改变的可能性，只要有一个人因为看过报导而改变了，反省也好，感动也好，警惕也好，行动也好，就有可能形塑一种新的环境公民力量，也有可能让错误的政策不再继续。1998年11月1日「我们的岛」节目正式播出，当年台湾的环境还处于大肆开发的年代，在经济挂帅的氛围中，「我们的岛」为环境发出另一种声音，至今「我们的岛」仍是台湾媒体中，唯一以「环境」为报导主题的新闻性节目，也是公共电视开播以来历史最久的新闻性节目，这十五年「我们的岛」制作

programme.title: 公视午间新闻第310集
programme.desc: 即时新闻，让听众得知最易于亲近的国内外大事。

programme.title: 喵的诈骗集团第1集
programme.desc: 街猫莫里斯和伪装成吹笛手的基斯、以危险豆豆为首的老鼠群，想出了一个完美的赚钱计划，联手诈骗纯朴小镇的人们。莫里斯派老鼠们在小镇出没，让基斯假扮吹笛手，以笛声驱赶老鼠离开，果然获得丰厚的报酬。但老鼠不想再继续下去，他们执意想去「快乐天堂岛」。莫里斯于是要求他们再进行最后一次诈骗，借此筹措前往圣地的旅费。此时，莫里斯的诈骗计划，同时也被镇长的女儿美丽西雅给识破了。

programme.title: 飞天扫帚五人行第1集
programme.desc: 善良的巫婆和她的小猫咪，总是一起骑在魔法扫帚上飞天遁地，四处趴趴走。在半空中时，巫婆经常一不小心就掉了东西。还好，热心的小动物们都会帮巫婆找回来，巫婆觉得好感动，就让这些小动物们也搭上她的魔法扫帚去翱翔。正当小猫咪任性地和其他小动物们争著扫帚上的座位时，巫婆遇上了生命危险…谁能够帮她逃出险境呢？

programme.title: 艺术很有事第109集
programme.desc: 探索视觉艺术、表演艺术、文学、电影、建筑、设计、大众文化等不同领域艺术的创作内涵，集结了众多艺术家的作品和所有工作伙伴的拍摄影像。

programme.title: 赤子第1集
programme.desc: 台北木偶剧团《赤子》是以侠义布袋戏为基底，从架空的朝代下，用富含隐喻的表演手法，激发观众对自身土地的共鸣与反思。

programme.title: 水火山第1集
programme.desc: 故事以传统习俗的殡仪馆为本体，写实描绘礼仪师讲述流程、大体冰存洗涤与上妆的日常，一位小男孩却在其间魔幻地游戏著。也捕捉了同仁集资送别无名大体的温暖。

programme.title: 全能冠军4第5集
programme.desc: 10名年约 12 至 16 岁的菁英运动员，分别来自夏季与冬季运动的专业选手。选手们要在短短三天内学会一项从未接触过的新运动。选手同时要担任自己擅长项目的「小教练」，教导其他参赛者。

programme.title: 谁来晚餐17第9集
programme.desc: 每一集纪录一个台湾家庭，并邀请他们的梦幻嘉宾到家里，一同分享彼此的生活经验、意见、人生观，是最能写实台湾的真人实境秀。

programme.title: 公视晚间新闻第311集
programme.desc: 《公视晚间新闻》因为新闻内容净化、几乎看不到其他台湾新闻台的血腥、火爆的场面，且素材多元，针对民生消费、台湾政经社会、人文环境等议题报导都极为深入

programme.title: 全球现场-深度周报第42集

programme.title: 喜马拉雅 虎之岛第1集
programme.desc: 聚焦于喜马拉雅山脉地区的野生老虎生态。该区域是地球上老虎密度最高的地区之一，透过尼泊尔的保育计划，当地老虎数量曾大幅成长。

programme.title: 我的麻吉4个鬼第1集
programme.desc: 地狱倒楣男阿纬举目无亲无依无靠，老板跑路工作也丢了，万念俱灰下只想结束自己倒楣的人生，没想到不仅死不成还被4个冤鬼缠身，衰上加衰！经过发发大师「降落」指点，只要完成4鬼遗愿就可以送他们安心上路，于是阿纬只好心不甘情不愿开始一段帮鬼圆梦的超级任务。

programme.title: 修不修第1集

programme.title: 邮票与舒芙蕾第9集

programme.title: 独立特派员第977集
programme.desc: 公共电视新闻部的十多名记者与工作人员，将回到自己的频道，开辟一个兼具调查采访和新闻杂志性质的新闻专题节目，「独立特派员」。 调查性或杂志型态的电视新闻专题节目，往往是一个电视台的新闻实力指标。为了在公共电视开辟调查性的新闻专题节目，服务更多观众，我们将以「新闻专题节目的领导品牌」为目标，回到公视频道制播独立、深度的调查性报导，以及提供多元、宽广视野的新闻专题。

programme.title: 一字千金第5集

programme.desc: 故事描述在前世分别为「河」与「石头」的两位女性，在今生相遇。这天「石头」带著「小河」前往高雄寿山探访天然钟乳石洞，在壮丽的喀斯特地形与自然山林间游历。两人透过攀爬、钻过狭窄岩缝的扶持与互动，慢慢产生情感的连结；当旅程来到最美的时刻，小河却隐隐害怕石头终有一天会离开。

programme.title: 嫁妆一牛车第1集
programme.desc: 《嫁妆一牛车》是一本由台湾作家王祯和所著之短篇小说合集，用台语写成，于1993年出版。内容刻画早期台湾农村底层人民的生活、家庭和男女情感关系，在台湾文坛有一定影响力。此书曾列入20世纪中文小说100强，第34强。其中单篇作品〈嫁妆一牛车〉于1967年在《文学季刊》发表，1984年被改编成剧本出版，稍后由张美君导演改编成电影。台视也于2001年推出相关电视剧。

programme.desc: 本节目以生活旅游方式呈现，介绍「豪华露营- Glamping」这个近年流行的新型态旅游方式，透过二位主持人，带领我们走访蒙古戈壁、西藏诺顿、土耳其阿瓦隆、印尼阿曼瓦娜等多国各地，记录如何在不同地区、风景、人文和多变多样的露营需求下，整体规划的思考脉络和英变措施。

programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 《初心。登场》单歌第9集
programme.desc: 延续「客家制噪」音乐盛典品牌，2025年结合实境拍摄全新打造「初心。登场」系列节目，团队跨越近一年时间纪录八组音乐人回归创作初心，挑战前所未有的「第一次」登台。从平均年龄最年轻的乐团到摇滚天后，从独立另类到流行经典，囊括金曲得主、经典唱将、演唱团体、亮眼新秀，多样曲风加上最感动的创作初心，联手专业团队打造出耗资千万的演唱会！

programme.title: 胡来旅行社2第1集
programme.desc: 承接《胡来旅行社》第一季的热情，这次再度出发将旅行社开进花莲！持续深耕在地、服务乡亲，带著重振观光的心，走访花莲各地，除了帮旅客安排客制化的旅游行程外，更希望为震后的花莲注入活水，让大家看见花莲不一样的魅力。

programme.title: 新北客音春风情第1集

programme.title: 客庄走透透第79集

programme.title: 学学嘴学学鼻(S3)第25集

programme.desc: 在印度西北部的丛林中，栖息著一个非凡的野生老虎家族。透过50年来累积的影像资料，我们将拼凑出这个母系氏族的壮阔传奇。

programme.title: 亚历山大的印度历险记第1集
programme.desc: 亚历山大阿姆斯壮首先拜访令人目不暇给的孟买，接著前往印度的权力中心德里。

programme.title: 亚历山大的印度历险记第2集
programme.desc: 亚历山大阿姆斯壮继续在印度境内探险，他走访了粉红之城斋浦尔、丝绸之城拉马纳加拉姆，以及班迪普尔国家公园。

programme.title: 亚历山大的印度历险记第3集
programme.desc: 亚历山大从孟买出发，先是搭乘市内崭新的地铁，随后前往世界上花豹密度最高的森林探险。接著他再度启程前往邦加罗尔，一座未来与传统兼具的印度科技重镇。

programme.title: 印度铁路纪行第1集
programme.desc: 跟著布拉德肖于1913年完成的印度、外国与殖民地旅游手册，迈克波蒂略将展开一场从阿姆利泽到西姆拉的经典铁路之旅。

programme.title: 印度铁路纪行第2集
programme.desc: 迈克带著布拉德肖于1913年完成的印度、外国与殖民地旅游手册，展开壮丽的铁路之旅，从拉贾斯坦邦的塔尔沙漠到印度首都，欣赏沙漠景观和令人赞叹的历史宫殿。

programme.title: 印度铁路纪行第3集
programme.desc: 布拉德肖于1913年完成的印度、外国与殖民地旅游手册引领迈克波蒂略踏上铁路之旅，探索现代印度南部的卡纳塔卡邦和坦米尔那都邦，从前土邦迈索尔到东印度公司的第一据点清奈，前称为马德拉斯。

programme.title: 印度铁路纪行第4集
programme.desc: 从北方邦的勒克瑙到西孟加拉邦的加尔各答的壮丽铁路之旅，迈克波蒂略带著布拉德肖于1913年完成、出版时适逢英国统治55年的印度、外国与殖民地旅游手册，勾勒出东印度公司时代到看见独立曙光的印度历史。

programme.title: 盖伊勇闯越南第2集
programme.desc: 盖伊深入探索越南的田野与工厂，亲眼见证这个一党专政的国家是如何以极快的速度在成为工业强权以及下一个世界级的高科技制造重镇。

programme.desc: 班深入挪威树林茂密的荒野，与两位与众不同的艺术家同住。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第2集
programme.desc: 这集的河中巨怪中，杰瑞米韦德前往巴布亚纽几内亚，这个以吃人肉、异教仪式、猎人头及激烈部落冲突闻名的国度，搜寻一种会攻击男性生殖器的河中水怪。刚抵达巴纽时，由于当地自然环境特殊，他已可预知这趟搜寻河怪的任务不会顺利，尤其是因为当地居民对外人充满极度的不信任，杰瑞米第一次尝试钓鱼时，便发生渔线被咬断的事，接著因为有人表示前不久才遭鳄鱼攻击，因此他一度怀疑咬断男性生殖器的事否可能为鳄鱼，很快推翻此假设后他重新展开追查，后来他钓到一条淡水鲳鱼，由于淡水鲳鱼属草食性，因此他当下便排除对此鱼的怀疑，然而经过几番折腾，他发现由于环境的改变，淡水鲳鱼已由草食性转变为同时具肉食特质的鱼种，加上先前遇袭的人的解释

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在本集中，佛莱迪和璜来到狄金森家位于亚利桑那州沙漠中的矿场。男主人弗莱德因新冠疫情而被裁员，采矿成了他们唯一的收入来源，而家里又人口众多。佛莱迪和璜改造了他们容易漏水的洗矿机，并解决泥沙淤积的问题，让他们的溜洗时间加倍，大幅提高产金量。

programme.title: 艾伦最强档新出路第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 这几年以来的生活相当过瘾，我挑战自己担任造车师傅，把我的技能磨练到完美。但打造美国改装车有高潮，也有低潮。现在我要寻找工作新出路，可以用上我的技能。所以我在美国探索不可思议的地方、行业和人，让美国保持运作。本集我见到我梦想中的引擎，还能领著把它嫁出门。找工作之旅也带我深入驱动煤矿业的引擎和机具，而我有机会实现每个小朋友的梦想，在铁路上工作，所以大家一起上车，和我一同追寻下个工作新出路，探究传统的动力世界。我是艾伦考夫曼，我需要新出路。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第5季:第10集
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察精挑细选古董旧货，交给工匠团队巧手修复，赋予全新生命。他们将看似无用的旧物修复成赚钱宝物，虽然客户挑三拣四，但潜在利润惊人。

programme.title: 原始生活21天第10季:第1集
programme.desc: 两位同是来自加州的求生好手山姆与莎拉，打算在非洲挑战原始生活21天。

programme.title: 亚当的超狂工作室第1季:第7集

programme.desc: 野生生物学佛瑞斯特葛兰特，专门寻找人类已经放弃的动物，这次他来到加拿大纽芬兰寻找纽芬兰白狼。纽芬兰白狼在87年前被宣告绝迹，但最近不但有人目睹而且还枪杀了一只，因此佛瑞斯特来到纽芬兰，协同狼行为专家查尔斯博格博士，一起深入山区，寻找传说中的纽芬兰白狼。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是加州的投弹甲虫。北美的投弹甲虫身长只有0.75公分，不过小小的身躯里却藏著惊人的化学武器；牠们受到攻击的时候，腹部腔室里的化学物质会融合在一起，再从屁股发射出炙热的烟雾砲弹，把敌人包围在有毒的化学烟雾当中，强力驱赶所有大型掠食者。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是马达加斯加雨林里的豹纹变色龙。牠是非常成功的掠食者，可以完美融入环境当中，即使就在你面前，也不容易发现。此外，豹纹变色龙的眼睛还能独立旋转，任何东西都逃不过牠的全能之眼；舌头击发的攻击力道和速度更是惊人，威力简直和建筑工地的落锤有得比。

programme.title: 百变水族箱第8季:第13集
programme.desc: 本周，团队将留在赌城，替鳞与尾爬虫店与篮球明星德马库斯考辛斯分别制作水族箱。爬虫店的水族箱除了鱼之外，一切以爬虫类与丛林风作为主题。而考辛斯则要求他的水族箱必须大过另一位球星安东尼戴维斯在纽奥良家里摆设的水族箱。

programme.title: 走出首尔-南韩的自然奇观第1季:第1集

programme.title: 热血兽医师第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 杰夫医生以收费低廉的佛心而闻名，因为他认为即使是低收入的民众，也应该享有负担得起的宠物医疗服务。这天一位饲主泪眼汪汪地带著她的爱犬前来求助，因为牠被马踢中头顶，头部出现凹陷且大量流血。这是相当罕见的病例，即使对经验老到的杰夫医生也是。但杰夫医生仍成功将伤狗颅窦内的骨头碎片一一取出，完成手术，救回牠的命。一只备受疼爱的幼犬腿部骨折，让佩特拉医生面临挑战，因为如果打错骨钉可不能重来。同时杰夫医生为野猫为患的社区解决问题，捕捉大量的野猫带回诊所做结扎手术。

programme.title: 野地团战军第1季:第2集

programme.title: 野地求生奇才第1季:第1集

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是南非的犰狳蜥。犰狳蜥的外观看起来仿佛是神话里的衔尾蛇，牠有咬力超强的双颚，一口就可以把猎物咬到粉身碎骨，此外，牠身上的锯齿状鳞片硬度甚至可媲美金属，全身蜷缩起来的时候宛如一座坚不可摧的堡垒。

programme.desc: 野生生物学佛瑞斯特葛兰特，专门寻找人类已经放弃的动物，这次他来到加拿大纽芬兰寻找纽芬兰白狼。纽芬兰白狼在87年前被宣告绝迹，但最近不但有人目睹而且还枪杀了一只，因此佛瑞斯特来到纽芬兰，协同狼行为专家查尔斯博格博士，一起深入山区，寻找传说中的纽芬兰白狼。

programme.title: 管教恶猫第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 洛杉矶的动物收容所猫满为患，而且每况愈下。当民间的收容所容量已达饱和时，许多幼猫就被送到市立收容所。由于幼猫需要大量的心力照顾，市立收容所没有人力支援，因此假如幼猫没有人认养就会被安乐死。然而洛杉矶根本没有足够的家庭可认养或收养这些猫咪，结果造大量无辜的幼猫面临死亡命运。好友动物协会发起洛杉矶不杀生运动，从市立收容所拯救出50只幼猫，将牠们送到收养家庭照顾到健康的八周，并完成疫苗注射和绝育手术。现在好友动物协会请求杰克森的协助，希望他有人脉能帮助这50只幼猫找到认养的人家。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是来自澳洲的蜜袋鼯。蜜袋鼯是一种可爱又讨喜的有袋动物，但其实在加州饲养蜜袋鼯并不合法；这回布莱德利和比利要执行一场救援任务，前往南加州的尤加利树林找出一只逃跑的蜜袋鼯，因为如果放任牠在野外的话，牠可是会变成破坏生态系的可怕杀手。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是南非隐鼠。牠们几乎一辈子都住在地底下；第一眼看到南非隐鼠的时候，肯定会注意到牠巨大的门牙。牠们会用门牙啃出一个地下王国，挖土的功力宛如隧道钻掘机之外，更像是天赋异禀的建筑师，牠们的地下洞穴不仅有好几间干燥的卧室，还有储藏食物的区块，甚至还有独立的茅坑。

programme.title: 捕蛇专家第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 捕蛇专家茱莉亚的工作充满惊喜，有时以为要捕的是蛇，但了现场才知道是蓝舌蜥，有时甚至会遇上茱莉亚最害怕的蜘蛛。

programme.title: 蛇之美
programme.desc: 《蛇之美》运用高画质摄影机，捕捉蛇类交尾、生育、猎食、进食、移动，以及感测周遭世界的情形。

programme.title: 走出首尔-南韩的自然奇观第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 在自然与文化交织的南韩土地上，人们展现出与大自然共生的生活智慧。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 杰夫医生以收费低廉的佛心而闻名，因为他认为即使是低收入的民众，也应该享有负担得起的宠物医疗服务。这天一位饲主泪眼汪汪地带著她的爱犬前来求助，因为牠被马踢中头顶，头部出现凹陷且大量流血。这是相当罕见的病例，即使对经验老到的杰夫医生也是。但杰夫医生仍成功将伤狗颅窦内的骨头碎片一一取出，完成手术，救回牠的命。一只备受疼爱的幼犬腿部骨折，让佩特拉医生面临挑战，因为如果打错骨钉可不能重来。同时杰夫医生为野猫为患的社区解决问题，捕捉大量的野猫带回诊所做结扎手术。

programme.title: 野地求生奇才第1季:第1集

programme.title: 野地团战军第1季:第2集

programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 超级蝙蝠车第42集
programme.desc: 蝙蝠侠、罗宾以及蝙蝠女孩因一起阴谋而离开蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠电脑于是将她的主机板复制到蝙蝠车上，赋予它们「生命」。刚诞生的「超级蝙蝠车」随即展开保卫已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及对抗邪恶敌人「 the Legion of Zoom!」的重大任务。跟著令人惊叹的超级车队一同前行，看剧中帅气的班姆、小碧、红鸟、巴夫，和蝙蝠飞翼是如何帮助蝙蝠侠、蝙蝠女孩和罗宾，一同守护高谭市的安全。纵使面对「Legion of Zoom」，或是其他高谭市恶名昭彰的超级反派，超级蝙蝠车都将使用他们令人难以置信的小装置和创意的团队合作来拯救这一天。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第439集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第114集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第301集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 金厉害潜水艇第126集

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第8集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 超级蝙蝠车第46集
programme.desc: 蝙蝠侠、罗宾以及蝙蝠女孩因一起阴谋而离开蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠电脑于是将她的主机板复制到蝙蝠车上，赋予它们「生命」。刚诞生的「超级蝙蝠车」随即展开保卫已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及对抗邪恶敌人「 the Legion of Zoom!」的重大任务。跟著令人惊叹的超级车队一同前行，看剧中帅气的班姆、小碧、红鸟、巴夫，和蝙蝠飞翼是如何帮助蝙蝠侠、蝙蝠女孩和罗宾，一同守护高谭市的安全。纵使面对「Legion of Zoom」，或是其他高谭市恶名昭彰的超级反派，超级蝙蝠车都将使用他们令人难以置信的小装置和创意的团队合作来拯救这一天。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第441集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第115集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 农场鸡动队第115集

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第303集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 金厉害潜水艇第132集
programme.desc: 年轻天真的海豚金厉害带领一艘装满鱼儿和海水的另类潜水艇，打算前往他们梦寐以求，具有纯净水源的陆地~拉斯维加斯。但这段奇葩的海陆大冒险沿途总是波折不断，有时内忧有时外患，一点也不平静…

programme.title: 汪汪队 小砾与工程家族第2001集
programme.desc: 小砾和他的工程狗狗家族一起搬到附近的建筑师小湾，他们在那里生活、玩耍，打造社区需要的所有设施。

programme.title: 动物大联盟第1季:第26集
programme.desc: 透过纪实的镜头画面一起认识动物的习性和生态，生动地介绍动物知识，展示动物世界的多姿多彩。感受动物大联盟的能量，看动物们各个深藏不露的好本领，尊重珍惜大自然，动物生态才得以永续生生不息。

programme.title: MOMO欢乐谷第11季:第50集
programme.desc: 最适合小朋友观赏的优质儿童律动节目。除了好听的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，还有哥哥和姐姐们的游戏大PK。另透过说故事的启发引导儿童们，为儿童们解答生活上和人际关系上的众多疑惑。

programme.title: 露营小玩家第7集
programme.desc: 全台唯一露营亲子节目 哥哥姐姐要带著大家走进大自然， 在美丽的山谷里露营， 在青翠的草原上玩乐， 露营小玩家，放假换个家。

programme.title: MO蜜点亮好朋友第18集
programme.desc: 想跟「MO蜜点亮」一起去闯关吗？节目中有四个关卡，会提出不同的问题，只要选出正确答案，就可以获得一个章，集满四个章即闯关成功啰！节目内容皆由生活出发，生活中小朋友会遇到的状况，友情小故事、逻辑推理、常用的生活英文以及可爱的舞蹈，在节目中展现出来；并设计成闯关题目，将要传达的理念结合其中，让小朋友以主观视角进行答题选择，在无压力的状态下学习成长。「MO蜜点亮好朋友」，由MOMO台的大明星-MOMO、小蜜、点点、亮亮，由孩子的视角及对话，让MO蜜点亮以好朋友的角色，陪伴小朋友们度过快乐的童年时光。

programme.title: ㄅㄨㄌㄨㄅㄨㄌㄨ，快乐学游泳第6集
programme.desc: 《ㄅㄨㄌㄨㄅㄨㄌㄨ，快乐学游泳》是一档学龄前儿童游泳节目，带著观众前的小朋友跟著主角小宁，一起展开一场快乐学游泳之旅！

programme.title: 碰碰红绿豆第1006集
programme.desc: 红豆妮与绿豆兵，是一对来自TOP星球的外星姊弟。在地球被天才发明家WHY博士收养，与拥有超能力的豆子朋友们展开充满趣味的每一天！

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀鱼第49集
programme.desc: 这是一个集音乐、舞蹈、娱乐为一体的儿童动画。讲述的是一群学龄前儿童在水下城市Bubbletucky中的各种经历。透过广泛的节目主题设定，以及多元具活力及启发性的水族教室，让学龄前小朋友们和节目里茉莉、吉儿和她们的鱼同学们，在音乐和欢笑里学习科学、数学、文学，一起探索及认识世界。

programme.title: 神木岛第1集
programme.desc: 爱吹牛的小学生小安，意外坠入异世界—神木岛。这个美丽的世界正因生态变异而面临危机，为了找到回家的路，他必须与当地的伙伴们组队，踏上寻找传说中「神木之心」的远征，在这段旅程中，他必须学会诚实、勇敢与合作，才能真正成长，并拯救这个接纳他的新家园。

programme.title: 昆虫岛第9集
programme.desc: 在某个昆虫岛上住了许多的昆虫，萤火虫亚当来到了昆虫岛，他发现自己和大家不同， 对身体会发光感到自卑，容易害羞又紧张的亚当，能和大家成为好朋友吗？

programme.title: 喵喵魔法盒第7集
programme.desc: Kit和Kate是一对兄妹，他们的家中有一个神奇魔法盒，放满心爱的玩具和宝物。两兄妹最爱跳进神奇的魔法盒，出发去探险，每次遇到不同挑战，两只活泼又顽皮的小猫咪懂得作出最正确的选择吗？

programme.title: DORA第9集
programme.desc: 朵拉（Dora）和她的猴子朋友Boots在雨林中展开的史诗级冒险。朵拉（Dora）和她的朋友们必须齐心协力，克服雨林中的重重障碍。

programme.title: Hello Kitty-Super Style！第9集
programme.desc: 在这部充满乐趣与动感的剧集中，Hello Kitty 是樱桃镇的友善英雄，总是竭尽全力帮助朋友，带来微笑与勇气。无论是克服恐惧、学会分享，还是尝试新事物，她都用善良和爱心展现超凡的力量。当朋友需要帮助时，她将成为探险家、侦探、厨师、歌星等角色，用智慧与勇气解决问题。Hello Kitty 的超级友谊精神团结了樱桃镇，让小镇更加温暖有爱！

programme.title: 袋鼠海滩救援队第27集
programme.desc: 在资深救生员的带领下接受训练，学习成为守护海滩的救生小队。当海滩出现突发状况时，他们总是第一时间出动，从帮助迷路的小海龟找到回家的方向，到协助被海浪冲离岸边的小朋友安全返回岸上，每一次任务都充满紧张刺激的海滩冒险，也展现出勇气、智慧与团队合作的力量。跟著 小庞、莉兹、洁玛、奈奈 一起展开充满欢笑的友谊大冒险！

programme.title: 汪汪队立大功-恐龙救难队第2集
programme.desc: 汪汪队是由一群勇敢的狗狗组成，并由机智勇敢的莱德担任队长。 镇上居民只要遇到困难，第一时间就会呼叫汪汪队来救援， 可靠的莱德队长与汪汪队，也一定会不负众望完成任务。

programme.title: 宝可梦地平线第3季-希望升空第103集
programme.desc: 拉库雅决战结束后一年。罗伊与船长皮卡丘一同继续冒险，得知有宝可梦出现异常行动的情报，展开调查。就在此时，带著勾魂眼的少年——乌鲁特也现身了。罗伊与乌鲁特在森林中目击到的，竟然是受到拉库质影响而失控的请假王!?拉库质照理说应该被消灭，为什么还会存在？另一方面，莉可则在就读石英学园……

programme.title: 哆啦A梦电影-新大雄的日本诞生第1集
programme.desc: 《哆啦A梦：新‧大雄的日本诞生》是哆啦A梦第36部长篇电影动画，原作《大雄的日本诞生》是在 1989 年上映，当时吸引了 420 万人次观影，是系列的历代之最。 本次电影描述的是，因为种种原因对这世界不满的哆啦A梦等人，打算来个史上最大的「离家出走」。但是，这世上完全没有他们的容身之处啊！「既然如此，那就回到七万年前的日本吧！」于是，哆啦A梦等人利用时光机，展开了一场惊天动地的离家出走。 哆啦A梦他们在 7 万年前的日本玩得很愉快，还做出许多只可爱的宠物，正当心满意足回到现代时，却在现代遇到了从 7 万年前的日本来的原始人「古古儿」？

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-我的搬家物语仙人掌大袭击！第1集
programme.desc: 以野原一家搬家至墨西哥而卷入一连串的事件展开为故事主轴。「谢谢春日部。再见了春日部。」 野原一家搬家了？在父亲广志的工作变动下，野原一家决定含泪和春日部的大家告别。不过在那里等待著他们的冒险却是会动的仙人掌？

programme.title: 蜂电影第1集
programme.desc: 刚从大学毕业的蜜蜂贝瑞班森，发现他在纽窝市唯一的职业选择就只有采花蜜，而感到前途一片黯淡，一心想要离开这种一成不变的生活。当他在无意间和一名纽约市曼哈顿花店女老板凡妮莎认识，他就违反了蜜蜂世界的头号大禁忌，那就是和人类交谈。

programme.title: 吉伊卡哇-特别版第20集
programme.desc: 主要描绘一群画风独特的小动物「小可爱的日常」。

programme.title: 超次元英雄欧米加队长第26集
programme.desc: 在古代，巨大生命体「角兽」曾统治著整片大地，拥有压倒性的力量。后来角兽一度销声匿迹，世界随之步入「猎人时代」——人类借助名为「角醒器」的装置驾驭角兽的力量进行战斗。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探电影-星星与月亮第1集
programme.desc: 为了解开失踪之谜，屁屁侦探动身前往比赛舞台所在的「星尘岛」。没想到这座岛屿表面上是璀璨的选秀会场，私底下却是犯罪组织「怪盗学院」的大本营！为了顺利潜入调查，屁屁侦探甚至不得不假扮成超级偶像。在阻止可怕阴谋的过程中，他与老对手「怪盗U」狭路相逢，两人决定放下恩怨、组成搭档，一同在充满谜团的推理与冒险中一步步逼近事件的核心真相。

programme.title: 我们这一家第33集
programme.desc: 我们这个家庭真是个有趣的组合：有个幽默搞笑的橘子、一个神经大条的花妈、还有一个憨厚可爱的花爸，加上一个闷骚的柚子，每天都发生许多令人捧腹大笑的趣事。这个节目充满了欢乐的生活场景，贴近我们大家的日常生活。连主题曲都充满了希望的氛围，绝对让你爱不释手。别错过这个精彩节目！

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-金矛勇者第1集
programme.desc: 被上天选定的勇者，即将觉醒！！自古以来有个传说，在超级黑暗世界里有金矛和银盾的存在，当黑暗大王达克制造危机的时候，传说中的金矛和银盾就会出动寻找能拯救他们的勇者。小新莫名其妙被宝物们选为勇者，让他不得不勇敢站出来拯救地球！但是大家都被封印住了，只靠小新的力量，真的没问题吗？

programme.title: 名侦探光之美少女第33集
programme.desc: 明智安娜是住在真心未来镇的14岁国中二年级生！在生日那天出现的精灵包包，以及房间里的项链引导下，她从2027年穿越时空来到1999年的真心未来市，她在那里遇见了向往成为名侦探的14岁少女小林未来！ 就在这时，事件发生了！？似乎有人因为重要的东西被偷走而伤透脑筋… 犯案的是幻影怪盗团 ！ 无法对需要帮助的人视而不见……！安娜与未来抱著这样的想法，变身成【名侦探光之美少女】。 名侦探光之美少女将用推理守护大家的笑容。「这个谜团，就靠天使破案！」而安娜是否能回到原本的时代呢……！？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主第52集
programme.desc: 主角青空阳葵和星川美月，一起进入私立乐园学园就读。对偶像公主怀抱著憧憬的阳葵，梦想是交一万个朋友！但这对怕生又容易紧张的阳葵来说，可能有点困难……没想到这样的阳葵，居然要以偶像公主的身分出道了？！她不小心有了连对好友美月都不能说的「秘密」！然而，美月似乎也怀抱著某个「秘密」……身怀秘密的阳葵和美月，两位偶像公主的故事，就此揭开序幕！！

programme.desc: 为了解开失踪之谜，屁屁侦探动身前往比赛舞台所在的「星尘岛」。没想到这座岛屿表面上是璀璨的选秀会场，私底下却是犯罪组织「怪盗学院」的大本营！为了顺利潜入调查，屁屁侦探甚至不得不假扮成超级偶像。在阻止可怕阴谋的过程中，他与老对手「怪盗U」狭路相逢，两人决定放下恩怨、组成搭档，一同在充满谜团的推理与冒险中一步步逼近事件的核心真相。

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-我的超时空新娘第1集
programme.desc: 某日，野原新之助（矢岛晶子 配音）正在公园里和风间（真柴摩利 配音）、妮妮（林玉绪 配音）等朋友们玩耍，意外遇见了一位名为金有久美子（钉宫理惠 配音）的神秘女子，久美子告诉小新，自己来自于遥远的未来世界，而彼时已经长大成人的新之助，正是自己的未婚夫。 跟随着久美子，小新一行人来到了未来，在那里，金友电机的社长，亦是久美子的父亲金有增藏手握大权，并且绑架了一直和自己作对的新之助。得知小新的到来会阻碍自己的计划，增藏派出了刺客，在强大的敌人面前，小新能否顺利救出新之助，并且帮助面前这个陷入了黑暗之中的世界重新找回光明呢？

programme.title: 三分野第4集
programme.desc: 东和集团大小姐向园，为了逃避家族联姻，与爷爷约定只要能让分公司维林一年的市场销售额提升10%，就可免除婚约。 她临危受命前往维林，却意外遇到了曾苦追不得的校园男神徐燕时。 两人从最初的职场较量，到互相扶持、共同成长，最终收获了事业和爱情。

programme.title: 美乐加油第13集
programme.desc: (2011)风靡全亚洲的音乐才子韩以烈(贺军翔饰演)是某卫视知名综艺节目的评委，他性格怪异，作风霸道，经常让暗恋他的经纪人楚少茵(柳岩饰演)为其收拾烂摊子。查美乐(王心凌饰演)是一个坚强善良的平凡女孩，她相信只要努力付出就有回报。为实现男友韩以风的梦想，她放弃自己的事业开了一家面包店。美乐阴差阳错之下与冷酷霸道的未来小叔以烈相遇，美乐的热情真诚如阳光般照进了以烈冷漠的内心。某著名餐饮连锁店创办人何言劭(张伦硕饰演)打算收购美乐的面包店，以风与美乐之间的感情出现危机，以烈陪美乐度过了人生最灰暗的时刻。少茵百般阻扰以烈与美乐的交往。言劭对美乐由欣赏到日渐动情。面对以风的回心转意、言劭的强烈追求和少

programme.desc: 《世界第一等》是台湾八大电视“大视界系列”的一个旅游节目，开播于2005年，该节目风格为探险走向，大部分节目会拜访当地台商及移民，了解当地台商的成功经验及与当地华侨一同探索该国家的文化和传统。《世界第一等》探访世界各地稀奇古怪、骇人听闻的风土民情，首集即报导越南畸形村，创下1点多高收视率，在市场上引起不小震撼。虽然这节目满足观众喜欢“窥视”新奇事务的心理状态，但也借此进行人道关怀。例如首集播出畸形村后，替中华民国红十字会募得新台币一百多万元，制作单位之后也随同中华民国红十字会秘书长郝龙斌至越南捐赠该款项。

programme.title: 戏说台湾第6256集
programme.desc: 天下合久必分，分久必合。举首问苍天，苍天无亟，民贱伏刍狗，狗甚幸。在这片土地上，流传著许多美丽动人的民间故事，它曾经过漫漫岁月的沉淀淬炼直到现在，这些故事依然守候在你我身边，散发出迷人的丰采。

programme.title: 宝岛渔很大LET’S GO FISHING第9集
programme.desc: 全新一季主持阵容也大洗牌，由「沈老爷」沈文程坐镇，首度搭档外景综艺玩家林柏升KID，并邀来「在家做生鱼片」百万点阅料理网红ELI，组成跨三世代的全新主持阵容

programme.title: 雨夜花第10集
programme.desc: 《雨夜花》是台湾日治时期的台语流行歌曲兼民谣，由周添旺作词、邓雨贤作曲。日本人柏野正次郎所经营的古伦美亚唱片公司将其灌录成78转的唱片，由旗下歌星纯纯主唱，于1934年推出。

programme.title: 金家好媳妇第128集
programme.desc: 剧情主轴描述人与人之间永远难以割舍的亲情与爱情;而婆媳之间那本「家家都有难念的经」是每个家庭必须要面对的课题，而在「金家」的屋簷下，除了有不同世代各式各样的婆媳问题外，还有，金家年轻人们多姿多采的爱情和人生。

programme.title: 三立晚间新闻
programme.desc:
《三立晚间新闻》为三立台湾台电视新闻节目之一。
2019年6月19日于晚间新闻起，启用全新摄影棚。

programme.title: 宝岛神很大
programme.desc: 三立爱台客创造"台潮"第一波最生活的民俗文化节目,让你亲近神的领域有趣味的民俗文化节目,要你说出Oh My God长知识的民俗文化节目,传承子孙不能忘本

programme.title: 超级夜总会
programme.desc:
节目类型分为两个部分，一个是「台湾好歌」；另一个是「台湾好秀」。耗资千万的大型移动车会行驶到台湾各个地方....

programme.desc: 在人群攘往熙来的繁华街道里，有个老味道静静记录著时间流逝。那或许是来自家乡的味道，也或许是和家人共处的幸福味道，当然也有可能是乘载梦想的味道。《台湾百味》将带您探索这些存在于台湾各处的味道，不仅让您用美味一餐满足饥肠辘辘，也用快乐的养分滋养心生命。

programme.title: 台湾百庙第334集
programme.desc: 每一座老庙，都拥有在地发展最初始的记忆；每一炷香火，都满载乡亲里民最虔诚的心意。百年来香火不断，世代间信仰不歇，寒来暑往，流转著许多动人的故事与传奇。《台湾百庙》带您悠游台湾各处宫庙，发现最在地的民间故事，品尝最道地的庶民小吃，体验最特别的民俗风情，探索最深植人心的宫庙文化。给您最不同以往的行脚文化之旅。

programme.title: 闪耀的她第8集
programme.desc: 管文，身为欧洲轻奢品牌缇柏逊的业务拓展部副总监，虽是公司内年资最浅的副总监，却因做事果断狠辣被誉为「千刀斩女魔头」，是公司里传言最有希望晋升下一任总监的候选人，而这最后一步的关键即是能否拿下恒天——一家齐聚了所有顶级奢侈品牌的国内排名第一商场。但在品牌拓展团队中还有位善于投机取巧的副总监莉迪娅处处与管文针锋相对，同样觊觎品牌拓展总监之位。为了获得与恒天高层林岳的见面机会，管文便联合闺蜜陈萱萱和景知秋，上演了一出「好戏」：身著优雅贴身小礼裙的管文先是在洗手间外制造了一场与恒天招商总林岳相遇的「意外」，岂料管文的巧计被林岳的一个电话打断，她回想起总监马特的忠告和莉迪娅的挑衅，便又借景知秋装醉巧取他

programme.title: 捉刀人
programme.desc: 冷酷无情的捉刀人裴兴，人称「豺狗」，长年替朝廷追捕法外之徒、以命换赏，孤身行走江湖。当他目睹坚守正义的人们惨遭强权杀害，他沉睡已久的侠义精神被唤醒，于是决定以牙还牙，奋起复仇严惩恶人。面对各路武艺高强的捉刀人接连追杀，裴兴能否在血雨腥风中，为冤死之人讨回公道？

programme.title: 仁寺洞丑闻
programme.desc: 一幅四百年前消失的画作「碧眼图」即将进行修复工程，如修复成功将创下韩国拍卖史上的最高天价。艺廊总裁裴太真聘请了号称拥有神鬼之手的修复专家李康俊进行修复工作，在修复过程中，各方势力的明争暗斗与隐藏的阴谋逐渐浮出台面。

programme.title: 临时决斗
programme.desc: 女强人林雪发现男友出轨，对象竟是女拳王孙雅云。为一决胜负，她拜师传奇拳王钟磊，在经营困难的拳馆学拳，却意外与钟磊之妻、曾有心结的女演员莫嘉莉重逢。历经挫败的林雪在伙伴鼓励下重振斗志，也促使钟磊决心与理念分歧的大徒弟展开对决。

programme.title: 头文字D (电影)
programme.desc: 藤原拓海每天驾著父亲的旧车运送豆腐，不知不觉练就出神入化的飘移技术。对汽车毫无兴趣的他被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟爆冷获胜，激发出他对赛车的渴望；面对接下来的高难度竞赛，拓海将全力以赴，誓言夺下秋名山车神的称号！

programme.title: 幸福房屋事件簿第3集
programme.desc: 房仲经纪人陆安琪为了处理爸爸留下的凶宅，带著有灵异体质的菜鸟助理游大志加入凶宅专案小组。

programme.title: 幸福房屋事件簿第4集

programme.title: 影子篮球员第75集
programme.desc: 称霸全国中学篮球大赛三年的超强学校帝光中学，因其篮球队才能之非凡卓越，而使正选的五名天才篮球手被称之为「奇迹世代」闻名于当世。但在五人之外，鲜为人知的还有以极端消除自己的存在感，以纯助攻活跃帮助场上五人的「幻之第六人」黑子哲也！升上高中后众人各自分散于各校，黑子为了打倒昔日的队友称霸全国，与在美国成长而归日之篮球好手火神大我携手合作，誓言成为最强的光与影攻辅组合，带领所属诚凛高中篮球部，夺得全日本高校篮球大赛冠军！

programme.title: 鬼灭之刃 无限列车篇第4集
programme.desc: 炭治郎等人完成「蝴蝶屋」的训练，抵达下一个任务地点「无限列车」。据说在短时间之内，有四十人以上的乘客在列车上失踪。炭治郎带著祢豆子与善逸、伊之助一行人，与鬼杀队最强剑士〝柱〞其中之一「炎柱‧炼狱杏寿郎」会合，在开往暗黑的「无限列车」上，与鬼正面对决。

programme.title: 死亡预报
programme.desc: 新闻直播5分钟前，电视台知名主播世拉（千玗嬉 饰）接到一名女子的电话，对方表示自己将被杀害。世拉认为这只是通恶作剧电话，但内心又感到十分不安，而世拉的母亲素贞（李慧英 饰）则认为，这是个能让世拉成为真正主播的好机会，让世拉决定前往对方的家，没想到却发现女子和其女儿陈尸在家中。此后，世拉眼前不断浮现那名女子死去的模样，并再次见到曾出现在案发现场的精神科医生仁浩（申河均 饰），对于曾是死者主治医生的仁浩，世拉对他的疑心愈来愈重……

programme.title: 白色情人节-鬼迷宫
programme.desc: 凝聚黑暗的大地,被高中学生们开朗的朝气所封印。最近学校接连发生原因不明的怪事,此时来了一名叫做熙敏的转学生,他不晓得自己的命运即将被翻转……在结界遭破坏的那一夜,他终于觉醒了!

programme.title: 唐伯虎点秋香
programme.desc: 在这部另类功夫喜剧中，学识渊博的才子迷上年轻娇俏的婢女。为了接近佳人，他精心筹谋。

programme.title: 犯罪都市2
programme.desc: 扫荡加里峰洞任务后过了4年，衿川刑警队前往越南引渡逃走的嫌犯。「怪物刑警」马锡道和全日万组长发现在当地的嫌犯十分可疑，得知其背后有个凶恶残暴的主使者姜海相。马锡道和衿川刑警队奔走于韩国和越南两地，开始缉捕史上最坏的家伙姜海相……

programme.title: 喜欢你
programme.desc: 男神金城武，金马奖影后周冬雨，首度同台飙戏。充满爱情甜蜜滋味的【喜欢你】由金奖导演陈可辛监制，由曾为【十月围城】、【亲爱的】等大片担当剪接师的许宏宇首次执导，【七月与安生】团队结合新科金马影后周冬雨与男神金城武共创爱情喜剧。本片改编自知名作家蓝白色超人气网路畅销小说《终于等到你》，从美食描写爱情关系，两位南辕北辙的男女竟因为一道菜色走在一起，天真萌妹恋上霸道总裁，展开鸡飞狗跳的美食龙凤斗！ 顾胜男是高级饭店餐厅的「千年二厨」，鱼干女性格的超级侠女，生活迷糊加上白痴，但是却是身手超级厉害的厨师，她和饭店总经理程子谦的秘密恋爱还没著落，没想到饭店财务危机而面临倒闭成为财团收购目标，程子谦此时又提

programme.title: 黄飞鸿之英雄有梦
programme.desc: 这个故事主要聚焦于黄飞鸿成为宗师之前的艰苦战斗与磨练，具有前传的特质。1868年，清朝末期，政府的腐败使得民众生活困苦。在广州，黑虎帮和北海帮两大恶势力在黄埔港肆无忌惮地活动。他们以暴力威胁掌控港口的贫苦百姓，使其生活在水深火热之中。外界看似黄埔港是繁荣且充满机会的地方，但深入了解后会发现，这里实际上是人间地狱。黑虎帮的首领雷公因一名新进手下阿飞的过人武艺和胆略，成功挑战了北海帮的首领，使黑虎帮独占鳌头，不仅借由鸦片获得巨额利益，还进行卑劣的人口贩卖。雷公对阿飞视如己出。但实际上，阿飞背后隐藏著另有故事，心中也有著其他计划。他与志同道合的朋友们设下圈套，拯救贫苦的人们，并公开挑战雷公，展开生死

programme.title: 七龙珠超-布罗利
programme.desc: 某天，现身于悟空和贝吉塔面前的是从未见过的赛亚人「布罗利」。本该随著贝吉塔行星的消灭而近乎灭亡的赛亚人，为何会在地球？而从地狱中再度归来的弗利沙军也被卷入其中？

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第195集
programme.desc: 跨世代的伙伴，一见如故的朋友，2位花甲艺人+2位少年艺人，一起趣旅行，他们会遇到什么样的事情？真实呈现旅行风貌

programme.title: 灌篮高手第9集
programme.desc: 日本漫画家井上雄彦以高中篮球为题材的漫画和动画作品，故事叙述一名国中时期便创下50次失恋纪录的著名坏学生 ─ 樱木花道，直到进入湘北高中，因为对同校女同学 ─ 赤木晴子产生好感，受到她的鼓励后，樱木决定加入篮球队，从此展开了他的篮球生涯...而湘北高中篮球队，有著第一中锋赤木以及明星球员流川枫，另外刚出院的后卫宫城和神射手三井也陆续归队，再加上自称为天才篮球手的樱木花道的加入，这五个人将合力一起进军神奈川区篮球代表队的对抗赛，并打入四强，之后更和四强中的海南、陵南、翔阳3校争夺全国大赛的代表权。过程不仅精采刺激，内容更是扣人心弦，充分表现出高中篮球选手不屈不挠且努力奋斗的精神！同时球队队友之间

programme.title: 鬼灭之刃 无限列车篇第1集
programme.desc: 炭治郎等人完成「蝴蝶屋」的训练，抵达下一个任务地点「无限列车」。据说在短时间之内，有四十人以上的乘客在列车上失踪。炭治郎带著祢豆子与善逸、伊之助一行人，与鬼杀队最强剑士〝柱〞其中之一「炎柱‧炼狱杏寿郎」会合，在开往暗黑的「无限列车」上，与鬼正面对决。

programme.title: 赛德克.巴莱(上)太阳旗
programme.desc: 赛德克，一个位于台湾山区、信仰彩虹的民族，他们居住在山岚缭绕的世外桃源，过著生态平衡的生活，族里马赫坡社出了一位英雄人物—马赫坡社头目之子莫那鲁道。但好景不长，日治时代的来临，赛德克族被迫改变原本生活，多数族里男人搬木服劳役，而女人沦为帮佣，祖先辛苦建立的家园和猎场，在日方统治下逐渐消失…。

programme.title: 尸杀军营
programme.desc: 一个军营爆发丧尸病毒，小兵Kayu和小队长Siao On侥幸没有被咬。两人伙同饭堂女主管的女儿一起奔逃，利用机智躲过满营丧尸，试图要杀出重围...。

programme.title: 刀锋剑客
programme.desc: 倒楣鬼猎犬汉克为了摆脱被霸凌的命运，来到一座属于猫咪的小镇，请求传奇猫武士金宝将他训练成一名武士，而金宝勉为其难地答应了。与此同时，大坏蛋伊卡正计划要将这个小镇从地图上消灭，汉克最终能成为猫咪们需要的英雄吗？

programme.title: 鬼咬鬼2
programme.desc: 肥宝一天做了个梦，梦里他与父母生前为他指腹为婚的朱家大小姐朱女私奔，误闯鬼屋，还被恶鬼追杀。后被师父九叔拍醒。 一夜肥宝卖粥遇见女鬼小红，他同情小红身世凄凉，故收留小红母女一人一鬼住进家中。后来小海怂恿肥宝，让他叫小红帮忙赚钱娶朱女，小红答应后逐向史公子色诱，不料却被识破，还被九叔发现，九叔大怒之下要将小红收回阴曹，肥宝为救小红，只好赶走九叔。朱员外原本欲将女儿嫁给有钱有势的史公子，但鉴于乡例难改，不得不改变初衷， 将朱女嫁肥宝，史公子不甘心之下，利用巫术将肥宝主魂驱出体外，收入袋中，幸好此事被小海发觉，立刻将肥宝的魂魄带回给九叔。于是九叔施展法术，决定以其人之道还治其人之身，将史公子之魂和肥

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 【危城】的故事背景设定在国家内战和军阀割据的动乱时期。普城保卫团的团长杨克难因为军阀少帅曹少麟谋杀了三名无辜者，决定将曹少帅绳之以法。然而，曹军拥有雄厚的财力和强大的势力，对居民造成了恐惧。曹军的上校张得知事件后，急忙赶往普城抓人，却意外地遇到了多年未见的师弟马锋。马锋是一位武艺高强的浪人，见义勇为想要出手相助，但却面临著正义与兄弟情谊的艰难抉择……

programme.title: 航海王电影-GOLD
programme.desc: 在伟大航路上闪耀著黄金般的璀璨光芒，有著世界最大的娱乐城市之称的「Grantesoro」，拥有者是吃了黄金果实的基尔德泰佐罗，有著与世界政府抗衡的财力与权力。误闯连世界政府都无法轻易干预的绝对圣域，草帽海贼团在世上最大的娱乐都市里，在一片欢乐的氛围中，发现了黄金大帝不为人知的可怕计划…。

programme.title: 当男人恋爱时
programme.desc: 剧情描述中，邱泽饰演的讨债者表面上看起来凶狠，实则内心柔软。在一次讨债的过程中，他对债主的女儿许玮甯一见钟情，并提出以「涂鸦合约」的方式，透过共进晚餐和散步来抵消她们家的债务。这种轻松随意的态度完全颠覆了许玮甯的生活，两人截然不同的个性究竟会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第196集
programme.desc: 跨世代的伙伴，一见如故的朋友，2位花甲艺人+2位少年艺人，一起趣旅行，他们会遇到什么样的事情？真实呈现旅行风貌
